narr: The combination of deep tropical moisture and a weak upper level area of low pressure produced heavy rainfall and flash flooding across portions of the Northwest Hill Country and Heartland.
ev: The Menard County Emergency Manager reported that Ranch to Market Road 1674 in southwestern Menard County is closed due to flooding.
Public reported 2 to 3 feet deep flood waters across RM 2291 in north-central Kimble County.
Law enforcement reported a flooded draw on Highway 915, north of Eldorado.
Law enforcement reported that portions of FM 1851 and U.S. Highway 71 were flooded.
Law enforcement reported cars stalled on Interstate 10 due to flooding.
Law enforcement reported flood waters were getting close to flooding homes on the south side of Sonora.

The Mason County Sheriff's Office reported two streets significantly flooded with approximately 3 feet of water deep over the road. In addition, four low water crossings in Mason County were flooded with a foot of water deep at each of those low water crossings.
The Menard County Emergency Manager reported flooding at the low water crossing at RR 865 and the San Saba River.
The Menard County Emergency Manager reported that a portion of RR 1773 is closed due to flooding.
The Menard County Emergency Manger reported that a portion of RR 1221 was closed due to flooding.
Law enforcement reported cars stalled on Interstate 10, 5 miles east of Sonora, due to flooding.
The Schleicher County Sheriff's Office reported that FM 915 was closed due to flooding, approximately 3.5 miles north of Eldorado.

The Kimble County Emergency Manager reported that numerous roads were flooded in Kimble County, with road closures at various locations. In addition, numerous streets are flooded in Junction and Roosevelt.
The Sutton Country Sheriff's Office reported flooding and road closures on parts of CR 864, CR 1691, CR 307, and CR 310. In addition, streets in and around Sonora are flooded as well.
The Sutton County Emergency Manager reported that homes were being evacuated in Sonora due to flooding.
